name: devops-date-badge
description: Chrome extension to display date age badges on Azure DevOps boards

scripts.build:content: tsc src/content.ts --target ES2020 --lib ES2020,DOM --module none --strict --skipLibCheck --types chrome --outFile content.js
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:content && vite build && node scripts/package-extension.mjs
